title: Enrolment request v1
description: Topic lefi/v1/enrol/{client_id}/request, client_id = enrol-<hardware_id as 12 lowercase hex>. MQTT user lefi-enrol, QoS 1, not retained, sent every 30 s until answered (ADR-058). A board without its own account asks to join; a person accepts it in Lefi Desktop only with the claim code the board prints (first 60 bits of SHA-256('lefi-claim-v1' || public_key), base32). The answer on lefi/v1/enrol/{client_id}/response is {v, hardware_id, alg: 'ECDH-P256+HKDF-SHA256+A256GCM', epk, nonce, ct}: the board's credentials sealed to public_key (HKDF salt 'lefi-enrol-v1', info and AES-GCM associated data = client_id).

mac.description: MAC of the interface it joined with

public_key.description: P-256 public key, SEC1 uncompressed (65 bytes), base64
